name: SmsQueue
description: Outgoing-SMS queue fed by MQTT: receives 'id|number|text' messages on a topic, validates them and hands them out one at a time (ESP32)

subscribe.description: Subscribe to the topic that carries outgoing SMS; call once after mqtt.connect (re-subscribed automatically on reconnect)

next.description: Take the next queued message; false if none. Its fields are then read with id(), number(), text(), is_valid(), error(), is_duplicate()

id.description: Message id of the current message

number.description: Destination number of the current message (+ and 5-15 digits)

text.description: SMS text of the current message (printable ASCII, max 160 chars)

is_valid.description: true if the current message passed validation

error.description: Why the current message was rejected (empty when valid)

is_duplicate.description: true if the current message id was already sent since boot (server redelivery)

mark_sent.description: Remember the current message id as sent, for duplicate detection

dropped.description: Messages dropped since boot (queue full, or no usable id)

pins.label: LED
pins.note: Activity LED via 330 ohm to GND

tips: Messages are buffered in RAM only: the server must redeliver anything not acknowledged within its timeout.
Text longer than 160 chars or numbers with letters are rejected, not truncated.
